 "content": "def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # A single-color separator divides the canvas into panels.
    rows = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    if rows:
        r = max(rows, key=lambda x: (sum(v != 0 for v in grid[x]), -abs(x-h//2)))
        above = [v for row in grid[:r] for v in row if v != 0]
        marker = max(set(above), key=above.count) if above else None
        below = grid[r+1:]
        if marker is not None and sum(v == marker for row in below for v in row) == 1:
            return [[marker]*w for _ in range(w)]
    if cols:
        c = max(cols, key=lambda x: (sum(grid[y][x] != 0 for y in range(h)), -abs(x-w//2)))
        left = {v for row in grid for v in row[:c] if v != 0}
        right = {v for row in grid for v in row[c+1:] if v != 0}
        shared = left & right
        color = min(shared) if shared else 0
        return [[color]*(h if c == 0 else c) for _ in range(h)]
    return grid
"
}
